- [USER] User expressed interest in the role of Artificial Intelligence in robotic surgery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI can play a critical role in robotic surgery by providing real-time data analysis and feedback to surgeons.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI improves surgical outcomes by enabling more precise and accurate movements, reducing complications, and improving patient outcomes.

- [USER] User found the information about AI in robotic surgery interesting.
- [USER] User inquired about current examples of AI being used in robotic surgery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci surgical system uses AI for real-time data analysis and feedback during procedures.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Stryker's Mako robotic-arm assisted surgery system uses AI to plan and execute joint replacement surgeries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Johnson & Johnson's Verb Surgical platform is being developed to use AI for planning and executing complex surgical procedures.
- [USER] User expressed amazement at how AI is revolutionizing the field of surgery and asked if AI would completely replace human surgeons in the future.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is highly unlikely that AI will completely replace human surgeons due to AI's limitations in decision-making and judgment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Surgeons have years of experience and training that allow them to handle unpredictable situations during surgery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Many patients prefer having a human surgeon for personal communication and relationship.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI can assist surgeons in performing procedures and achieving better outcomes by analyzing data and providing insights.
- [USER] User acknowledged the importance of a personal connection with a surgeon and asked if AI could reduce surgical errors caused by human error.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI has the potential to reduce surgical errors and complications caused by human error by analyzing large amounts of data quickly and accurately.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI algorithms can help identify potential risks and provide real-time feedback during surgery.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI can analyze a patient's medical history and imaging data to identify potential complications or contraindications.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] AI technology can provide real-time feedback to ensure correct positioning of surgical instruments and proper procedure execution.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] By reducing surgical errors, AI can improve patient outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.
